segments.name: Biotechnology
products: medical devices and other related products
segments.description: Single reportable segment selling medical devices, pancreatic cancer early detection services and contact lenses, serving licensed healthcare professionals and clinical customers.
segments.evidence: Management determined that the Company's operations constitute a single reportable segment in accordance with ASC 280.

revenueModel.text: Licensed healthcare professionals order cancer detection testing through a CLIA-certified laboratory, and customers purchase medical devices, related products and contact lenses.
revenueModel.evidence: We currently market our cancer detection test products exclusively to licensed HCPs, who order testing through EG BioMed's CLIA-certified and CAP-accredited laboratory.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company completed its Business Combination with Breeze and YD Biopharma, which became wholly-owned subsidiaries.
changes.evidence: On August 28, 2025, the Company completed its Business Combination with Breeze and YD Biopharma.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company acquired patents and commenced the pancreatic cancer early detection service and contact lens sales business.
changes.evidence: The Company acquired the 3D Global Patent and EG BioMed Patent in June 2024 and commenced the pancreatic cancer early detection service and sales of contact lens business.
